windows.60: Over the past 60 days, several visitors have expressed concerns about the food options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, noting that the menu is limited and some dishes lack flavor or proper preparation. There were specific complaints about bland or poorly combined items, and some felt the food was overpriced given the portion sizes and choices available. Service and wait times were also mentioned by a few reviewers, though less frequently. Overall, the average rating remains above four, but attention to food quality and menu variety could improve the visitor experience.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate several issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many guests found the menu limited and the food quality inconsistent, with some dishes described as bland or poorly prepared. Pricing was frequently mentioned as too high for the portion sizes and quality offered. Service problems were also noted, including long wait times and periods when kitchen orders were not being taken. These concerns suggest a need to review the menu options, pricing, and kitchen operations to improve the visitor experience.
